mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for at least 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month signals strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand over the past month signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a stimulative economic environment that boosts consumer spending and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
